problems.problem: The floor still renders as large-format stone slabs, not the declared single honed plane. In the contact crop [189,983,891,1233] a bright grout seam exits vertically straight down from beneath the strap-loop base (crop x≈350 → poster x≈539) and a second horizontal joint crosses the crop at crop y≈215 (poster y≈1198); in the full poster further diagonal joints rake across the lower-left floor. The brightest cue under the hero is therefore a grout line cutting its contact zone, contradicting 'one seamless continuous honed basalt plane'.
problems.root_cause: The executed background.prompt (repaired batch) says 'single unbroken surface' but never explicitly forbids joints/seams/grout, so the generator again laid a slab grid whose seams intersect the product base zone.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate with a prompt that explicitly names the forbidden artifacts (no joints, no seams, no grout, no tile or slab lines, no veining grid) while keeping the same low junction, near-black plaster void and left-biased wash; do not touch product geometry or copy.

problems.problem: The preserved packshot key on bezel, lugs and crowns is upper-front-left, but the environment reads frontal-symmetric: the void gradient is brightest around the upper-center/left-center with no measurable falloff gradient toward the right, and the floor shows no left-pooled mineral sheen. The 'museum spotlight from the left' logic of Night Monument is stated by the product but not by the room.
problems.root_cause: Wash direction in the prompt is described but not enforced against the generator's default centered vignette; the deterministic glow ellipse (#232A33 at 0.9) sits centered behind the case and reinforces the symmetric read.
problems.repair_strategy: Rewrite the background prompt to demand a visibly raking cool wash entering from upper front-left with progressive falloff to the right edge and a left-pooled sheen on the stone; shift the glow ellipse slightly left of the case axis so halo and wash agree with the baked key.

problems.problem: The contact crop confirms contact IS present: the strap-loop base terminates on the stone at y=1123 with a soft dark zone under it (shadow is not absent, offset_y 0 is correct). But at opacity 0.5 / blur 14 over near-black basalt the pooled darkness is barely separable from the floor value, while the adjacent grout seam is brighter than the shadow; the monument reads as resting by silhouette coincidence rather than by weight.
problems.root_cause: Shadow alpha and footprint still too modest for a ground that already sits near black; width_scale was never raised in the executed batch (only opacity/blur were).
problems.repair_strategy: Keep offset_y at 0 (correct contact) and raise the footprint: shadow.width_scale toward 1.3 and opacity toward 0.6 so a pooled dark ellipse wider than the strap loop reads under the base instead of the grout line.

problems.problem: Typography tiers improved (title bbox height 63px vs logo 18px vs subtitle 22px now read as three weights), but the left type column stops at y≈232 while the product mass starts at y≈317 and the entire right half of the frame above the floor junction is unread void: the promised halo ellipse (#232A33, opacity 0.9, bbox [339,516,741,1039]) is only ~24 value-steps above #0B0D10 and is invisible in the render, so the negative space never becomes the deliberate halo of reference image 5 and the left column floats without a counterweight.
problems.root_cause: Glow ellipse value too close to the void color and the symmetric vignette cancels any pooled read; negative space is empty rather than composed.
problems.repair_strategy: Lighten the single glow ellipse one step (e.g. #2A323C) and bias it slightly left/up behind the case so the void reads as a lit halo balancing the masthead column; keep the primitive list complete and within budget.

problems.problem: Portfolio-level review stands from the previous round: Night Monument and Winter Horizon share the identical stage mechanism (horizon band + pooled ellipse under a standing product + renderer contact shadow), differing only in palette; this poster is retained as a draft pending that structural revision in a sibling concept, not as a failure of its own craft.
problems.root_cause: Concept portfolio contains two mechanically identical stagings; rubric excludes palette-only differentiation.
problems.repair_strategy: In the sibling concept, convert one of the pair to a zero-horizon pure negative-space void or a dial-grammar abstraction using only permitted flat primitives; keep this poster's monument stage intact.

creative_diversity_evidence.evidence: Judging mechanisms, not names: Emblem Field mounts the cutout on a stacked flat rectangle+ellipse field with a lateral original-alpha silhouette double and a rule; Night Monument and Winter Horizon both build the identical stage — one horizon-band rectangle behind the opaque silhouette, one ellipse disc/glow pooled under the standing watch, one renderer-cast contact shadow — differing only in near-black vs pale-blue palette, which the rubric explicitly excludes as differentiation; Certificate Page abandons graphic staging entirely and makes the four locked text layers plus one ruling line around an untouched packshot the event. Execution audit: each concept uses one unrotated, uncropped source photograph, no duplicated product, no macro plates, no diptych; primitive budgets hold (Emblem Field: rect+ellipse+silhouette+line = 4; Night Monument: horizon band+glow ellipse = 2; Winter Horizon: sky field+horizon band+snow disc+glow = 4; Certificate Page: 0 primitives + 1 line); no relighting is claimed (dark/pale environments sit behind the opaque silhouette and the cutout keeps its source key); no new slogans, model numbers, certifications or gemstone grades are invented, and the empty price is preserved. Dial grammar (Roman indices, double-digit date under XII, small-seconds subdial printed РОССИЯ/КВАРЦ, two crowns) is only referenced descriptively, never altered.
